title: Patch: Salt and Slow Down
story: Hash passwords with a random salt, and repeat the hash many times to make guessing slow. (Real systems use a ready-made function such as scrypt, bcrypt or argon2. Here you build the idea by hand, because a browser Python has no such library.)
goal: Write make(pw) returning "salt$hash" (hex), hashing salt+password with SHA-256 2000 times, and check(pw, stored) that verifies it.
hints: A salt is random text mixed into the password before hashing, so equal passwords get different hashes.
Make the salt with secrets.token_hex(8), then loop 2000 times: h = sha256(h + salt + pw). Store salt + "$" + h.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
